deep_meaning: The root K-B-R means to be great, to be greater, to be beyond measure. When you say Allahu Akbar, you are not comparing Allah to something. You are declaring that Allah is greater than anything the mind can compare.
why_this_phrase: Allah is greater than every worry and every fear. This phrase is said when something feels too big, and it reminds the heart that Allah is bigger.

verses.arabic: وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ
verses.translation_en: Allah has promised the believing men and believing women gardens beneath which rivers flow.
verses.context: The promise that is greater than anything the world offers.

verses.translation_en: And the remembrance of Allah is greater.
verses.context: It places remembrance above all other acts.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّهُ إِذَا دُعِيَ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ كَفَرْتُمْ ۖ وَإِن يُشْرَكْ بِهِ تُؤْمِنُوا ۚ فَالْحُكْمُ لِلَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْكَبِيرِ
verses.translation_en: That is because when Allah was called upon alone, you disbelieved; but if others were associated with Him, you believed. So the judgment is with Allah, the Most High, the Most Great.
verses.context: Al-Kabeer as one of the names of Allah.

verses.translation_en: Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Grand, the Exalted.
And that Allah is the Most High, the Most Great.

when_to_say.moment: When you witness something beyond you
